messages:
maya: heads-up — reproduced consistent cold prefill p95 spikes when switching to fp8-KV on 30B. Memory drop ~24% vs int8, but p95 from ~120ms -> ~260ms on first prefill step. stack trace shows dequant fallback. attaching run id 2026-03-kvfp8-01
bench-bot: quick summary: run 2026-03-kvfp8-01: mem_delta=-24%, p50=90ms (int8 85ms), p95=260ms (int8 120ms), cold-prefill-90th-step lat jump at step 3. link: https://bench/reports/2026-03-kvfp8-01 :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam: is this during the KV handoff (prefill->kv cache activation) or steady-state queries?
maya: handoff. steady-state p95 is fine (~110ms). spike only on the first request after cache materializes.
ashley: hypothesis: fp8 dequant path triggers slow memcpy/format convert path on first access causing kernel serialization. seen similar on earlier fp8 casting work.
diego: can you paste the exact cmd and log snippet to repro?
maya: paste:
```
./run_bench --model redwood-30b --kv-quant fp8 --preload=kv --batch-size=1 --seed=42
[2026-03-10 14:02:13] kv_dequantize: fallback to scalar_dequantize
[2026-03-10 14:02:13] copy_kv_tensor bytes=16777216 cudaMemcpyAsync -> sync
[2026-03-10 14:02:13] kernel_launch_delay 3.2ms
```
riley: try this quick experiment: keep on-disk KV in int8 (smaller decode penalty) but tag runtime to use fp8 compute paths for new writes. If handoff uses int8->fp8 conversion lazily it might avoid a big synchronous dequant.
ops-bot: note: observed GPU OOMs on some fp8 runs when attempting in-place cast; may need bumping reserved pool by +256MB. raising infra ticket INF-4392.
bench-bot: added a shadow run "kv-handoff-cast" to compare. current diff:
- int8 baseline p95_cold=120ms mem=3.2GB
- fp8-KV p95_cold=260ms mem=2.44GB
- hybrid int8-on-disk p95_cold=150ms mem=2.6GB
artifact: https://bench/reports/2026-03-kvfp8-handoff
maya: thanks. plan: run targeted kernel-level profiling (nsys) for the handoff path, and try lazy cast path that riley suggested. will post results.
liam: if it helps i can run with controlled multi-tenant noise to ensure not infra fluke.
ashley: also add a small eval for quality — FP8 KV may slightly change logit deltas on long-context Llama style prompts. not just perf.
diego: noted. setting up a canary with 1% traffic for dedicated pool with hybrid config to validate.
